title: Metallic vs Non-Metallic Boundary Prediction

pipeline: 1. For Z=1-18, compute Z_eff/Z ratio from SDT screening
2. Metals have lower Z_eff/Z (more screened), nonmetals higher
3. Check if boundary falls between metals and nonmetals

conclusion: 11/18 correct. SDT screening ratio provides partial metal/nonmetal boundary prediction.
